modelRouting.routingRationale: The host-state implementation and append-only setup CLI grammar have disjoint files and a frozen public API; their shared acceptance test must wait for both integrated outputs.

objective: Implement M3 only: machine setup/state lifecycle through one native host registry and one append-only CLI surface, preserving the accepted M2 plugin-root Serve contract and truthfully blocking unavailable external qualification.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of primary checkout HEAD, index, validation, commit, and push; may not edit lane-owned files

interfaceLock.hostState: Before source edits, legion_host::setup_registry public API is frozen. All public models derive Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize. pub const SETUP_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 1. pub struct BoundRelease { release_version: String, runtime_digest: String, capability_catalog_hash: String, mcp_tool_schema_hash: String, declarative_asset_schema_hash: String, state_compatibility: String }. pub enum SetupAction { Preview, Apply, Status, Repair, Disable, Remove, Purge }. pub enum ClientSelector { AllSupported, ClientId(String) }. pub struct ClientEvidence { client_id: String, detected: bool, mechanisms: Vec<String>, command_proof_ref: Option<String>, qualification_evidence_ref: Option<String> }. pub struct SetupRequest { action: SetupAction, selector: ClientSelector, release: BoundRelease, platform_state_root: PathBuf, client_evidence: Vec<ClientEvidence>, dry_run: bool }. pub struct DetectedClient { client_id: String, selected_mechanism: String, fidelity: String, missing_surfaces: Vec<String>, remediation: Vec<String> }. pub struct SetupPreview { plan_id: String, plan_digest: String, request: SetupRequest, clients: Vec<DetectedClient>, mutations: Vec<PlannedMutation>, backups: Vec<BackupRecord>, rollback: RollbackPlan, external_qualification: ExternalQualification }. pub struct PlanConfirmation { plan_id: String, plan_digest: String }. pub struct ConfirmedSetup { preview: SetupPreview, confirmation: PlanConfirmation }. pub struct ClientStatus { client_id: String, installed: bool, fidelity: String, bound_release: Option<BoundRelease>, missing_surfaces: Vec<String>, remediation: Vec<String> }. Support types are PlannedMutation { target: PathBuf, operation: String, digest: String }, BackupRecord { target: PathBuf, snapshot: PathBuf, digest: String }, RollbackPlan { generation: String, snapshot: PathBuf, release: BoundRelease }, SetupExecution { action: SetupAction, generation: Option<String>, clients: Vec<ClientStatus>, remediation: Vec<String>, external_qualification: ExternalQualification }, RecoveryReport { recovered_generation: Option<String>, remediation: Vec<String> }, RuntimeLease { lease_id: String, client_id: String, generation: String }, StateLock { lock_path: PathBuf }, SetupState { schema_version: u32, migration_generation: String }, ExternalQualification { status: ExternalQualificationStatus, missing_evidence: Vec<String> }, and ExternalQualificationStatus { Qualified, ExternalQualificationBlocked }. pub trait SetupStore has exact methods platform_state_root(&self) -> &Path; load_state(&self) -> Result<Option<SetupState>, SetupError>; write_state_atomic(&mut self, state: &SetupState) -> Result<(), SetupError>; snapshot(&mut self, generation: &str) -> Result<BackupRecord, SetupError>; restore(&mut self, rollback: &RollbackPlan) -> Result<(), SetupError>; acquire_exclusive_lock(&mut self) -> Result<StateLock, SetupError>; release_exclusive_lock(&mut self, lock: StateLock) -> Result<(), SetupError>. pub struct OnDiskSetupStore has private fields and exact public constructor open(platform_state_root: PathBuf) -> Result<Self, SetupError> plus state_path(&self) -> &Path. pub struct SetupRegistry<S: SetupStore> has private fields and exact methods open(store: S, release: BoundRelease) -> Result<Self, SetupError>; recover(&mut self) -> Result<RecoveryReport, SetupError>; detect(&self, selector: &ClientSelector, evidence: &[ClientEvidence]) -> Result<Vec<DetectedClient>, SetupError>; status(&self, selector: &ClientSelector) -> Result<Vec<ClientStatus>, SetupError>; preview(&mut self, request: SetupRequest) -> Result<SetupPreview, SetupError>; confirm(&self, preview: SetupPreview, confirmation: PlanConfirmation) -> Result<ConfirmedSetup, SetupError>; execute(&mut self, confirmed: ConfirmedSetup) -> Result<SetupExecution, SetupError>; rollback(&mut self, rollback: RollbackPlan) -> Result<SetupExecution, SetupError>; acquire_runtime_lease(&mut self, client_id: String, generation: String) -> Result<RuntimeLease, SetupError>; release_runtime_lease(&mut self, lease: RuntimeLease) -> Result<(), SetupError>. impl SetupRegistry<OnDiskSetupStore> has exact open_on_disk(release: BoundRelease, platform_state_root: PathBuf) -> Result<Self, SetupError>. SetupErrorCode is exactly { ClientNotDetected, ClientMechanismUnsupported, PlanConfirmationRequired, PlanStale, ConfigOwnershipConflict, ConfigParseRefused, PathEscapeRefused, SourceCheckoutReferenceRefused, CommandResolutionFailed, ReleaseBindingMismatch, VerificationFailed, RollbackFailed, PurgeOwnershipUnproven, PlatformStateRootInvalid, StateMetadataInvalid, StateSerializationFailed, StateLockUnavailable, RuntimeLeaseActive, SnapshotFailed, JournalIncomplete, RecoveryFailed, ExternalQualificationBlocked }; SetupError { code: SetupErrorCode, remediation: String }. C constructs only OnDiskSetupStore through open_on_disk, uses the frozen serde models, and never guesses H storage behavior. Preview is non-mutating; execute requires ConfirmedSetup with matching plan_id and plan_digest. H may add private helpers only; C compiles against these exact names, fields, signatures, serialization, meanings, and failure mapping.
interfaceLock.platformRoot: This field corrects the generic open_on_disk construction wording in hostState. legion_host::platform_state_root() derives only directories_next::BaseDirs::data_local_dir().join("Legion"), never a caller-supplied temporary, source-checkout, project, plugin, or client path. SetupRegistry<OnDiskSetupStore>::open_platform(release) is the sole product CLI constructor. open_on_disk(release, root) is a low-level/test seam only. H alone owns directories-next and the resulting engine/Cargo.lock resolution; C accepts no state-root argument.
interfaceLock.cli: C adds only legion setup grammar/dispatch and bare setup status through the frozen host API. It preserves byte-for-contract the accepted M2 legion serve --stdio --plugin-root ${PLUGIN_ROOT} parsing, package-root containment, release-binding verification, MCP startup, and M1 status --config behavior; it does not reinterpret Serve or MCP.
interfaceLock.state: Canonical durable state is only the verified platform-user-data Legion root. Setup state validates ownership/reparse containment, holds one exclusive lifecycle lock, records client-owned runtime leases, snapshots/journals before migration, atomically activates or rolls back exactly one generation, recovers interrupted work fail-closed, and purges only explicit verified Legion-owned targets.
interfaceLock.qualification: Repository-local M3 implementation may return EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED for unavailable signed macOS/Windows artifacts, Homebrew/WinGet paths, RightKit AX, or real-client environments. M6 alone owns immutable signed-artifact, platform-package, real-client, and Full-fidelity qualification; M3 never fabricates PASS, publication, or release claims.
